How to use this app
• Tap any day to open and read it.
• Swipe left or right, or use the arrows, to move between days.
• Tap Listen to hear the devotion read aloud.
• Tap a Further Reading verse to open it in the Bible, then ← Back to return to where you were.
• Tap Share for text, an image, or a PDF.
• Tap ✦ My reflection to write a private note, saved on your device.
• Use the calendar button at the top to jump to any past date.
About
The word with Joshua Kakaire — a daily devotional that walks with you through the whole year. Each day brings a verse, a reflection, a confession and further reading. Devotions unlock on their date; today’s is always on the home screen.
Sharing
Devotions may be shared in full and unchanged, with the author’s name attached. Copying, editing and downloading are switched off for readers.
Install this app
Install The Word on your phone, tablet or computer. It opens like a normal app, full-screen, and works offline once installed.
